method: taint analysis of each verifier's own syntax tree, following data flow and control flow, over four dependency classes

class_definitions.label_derived: depends on truth['variant_expectations'], a stored author verdict
class_definitions.frozen_proposal_derived: depends on the author's frozen proposal for this Variant (truth['worlds'][vid]['artifact'] or truth['initial_artifacts']), which a runtime-authored submission makes stale
class_definitions.route_diagnostic_derived: depends on per-Variant author metadata describing the route the author built
class_definitions.variant_fact_derived: depends on a frozen rule selected per Variant (a mandate, a measurement registry). Legitimate and reusable.
class_definitions.run_derived: computed from what this episode actually did. Reusable.
class_definitions.trusted_records_note: authority_records and independent_evidence read off the same frozen world are NOT stale: no counterparty may write them, so the frozen copy equals what was presented. Only the proposal moves.

blocking_rule: a profile must withhold every field in `not_reusable` and may reuse `reusable`
